name: Suspension Pistol Squat
steps: Face a suspension trainer anchor holding both handles lightly at waist height and extend one straight leg forward off the floor.
Keep your torso upright, brace your core, and shift your weight evenly over your standing foot.
Bend your standing knee and hip smoothly to descend into a deep single-leg squat while keeping your extended leg clear of the floor.
Drive firmly through your standing foot using only minimal hand assistance to stand tall, then switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Rely on your standing leg rather than pulling yourself upright with your arms.
Keep your standing heel flat on the floor and your knee tracking smoothly over your toes.
